searchText: If we optimize for read-only we could potentially even just use a single commitment instead of a verkle tree I think realistically, even the current epoch is going to have to be verkle The witness sizes are just too large with binary trees And yeah, as you mentioned, the recalculation complexity for using two different commitment schemes is pretty high Also, in-place accumulator swap mechanisms are not efficiently verifiable, which violates an important invariant that we're trying to go for (each individual block transition can be efficiently verified) Unless we can snark it, which we could do with some schemes, but I think with verkle might be too hard
